professional.summary.title: SUMMARY
professional.summary.body:
Global localization expert, game producer, and project manager with extensive international experience leading multicultural teams through successful production cycles. Skilled in optimizing processes, implementing best practices, proactively identifying risk, and unblocking issues to create successful products and experiences while fostering a workplace that values accountability and honesty.
Fluent in Chinese (Mandarin) and known for working with diverse multinational teams, serving as a trusted liaison with international partners and IP stakeholders while maintaining clarity, accountability, momentum, and cultural respect.
